name: Retro console low-poly
one_line: Wobbly low-res textures, hard polygons and close fog.
look_words: Three-dimensional graphics as they looked on a late-1990s home console. Very few polygons with hard edges, small blurry textures that swim a little, no smooth shading, a low screen resolution with visible dithering, and fog that hides everything past a short distance. Colours are muted: dull greens, grey stone, brown dirt, a slate sky. Yellow and cyan mark pickups and the goal, red is harm, and the player wears a clear blue. Shapes are blocky; trees and small things can be flat cut-outs that turn to face the camera. Motion is slightly stiff and snappy. Avoid smooth shadows, high-resolution textures, soft lighting, bloom and anything too clean.

palette.name: retro console
palette.notes: Close, thick fog is part of the look and also hides how small the world is. Keep the palette muted so the accents do the talking.

look_wish: low resolution with dithering and wobbly vertices

upgrade.why: the full treatment: snapped vertices, warping textures, low resolution and dither

music.mood: lo-fi sampled strings and a slow drum loop
music.notes: Low sample rate, a little hiss.

sound_feel: crunchy, low sample rate; short reverb, chunky menu blips

frames.prompt: Late-1990s home console 3D look: a very low-polygon knight in a blue tunic stands in a blocky castle courtyard with a stone well, wooden crates and a portcullis, seen from a third-person camera. Small blurry low-resolution textures that warp slightly, hard polygon edges, visible dithering, no smooth shading, muted colours, dark distance fog close behind the walls, slightly jagged pixels. Nostalgic and a little mysterious. Gameplay view of a stylised indie video game, no text, no user interface, no logos, no watermark.
